representation_fit.evidence: Both screenshots show a hierarchical batch-management console exactly matching the brief's shape bundle (many/high-hierarchy/high-density entities, manage verb): left org tree 华东大区›上海›静安门店 with counts (1280x860.png), center 59-device dense table, right 批量操作区. Tree + checkbox-list + batch panel is the canonical representation for '大量有层级归属的结构化实体集合' (source/js/data.js:13-31 group tree; source/js/app.js:166-227 tree rendering).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Batch workflow dominates the initial screen: dedicated right panel headed 批量操作区 with the four batch actions 修改状态/移动分组/添加标签/删除设备 (source/index.html:57-70), group checkboxes in the tree with 仅直属/含子孙 scope toggle (index.html:29-34), row checkboxes + master checkbox (app.js:290,268), and an empty-state that instructs the selection flow (1440x900.png right panel: 未选择任何设备…).

time_to_understand.evidence: Initial screen is self-explanatory: title 设备资产批量管理台 (index.html:15), top status chips with counts (1280x860.png header), panel labels 组织层级/批量操作区, and explicit hint text explaining the scope semantics (index.html:34; screenshot left panel). Status attribution is labeled directly in-row: 跟随上级 pill plus 生效状态·归属 with provenance 系统默认/自身设定/继承·浦东门店·门店改造中 (1440x900.png table columns; app.js:74-83,275-276).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (device entity) is visible with zero steps on load — 59 rows rendered immediately in both screenshots (显示 59 / 59 台). Group subtree focus is one click on a tree name with breadcrumb path traversal (app.js:197-203,230-249); batch actions are one click from selection in the permanent right panel (index.html:63-68). No modes or page changes required.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions run in place: batch ops open an overlay confirmation sheet listing every affected device with per-device exclusion and live delta previews (app.js:461-629), single-device status uses a popup menu (app.js:744-763), results return to an in-panel result card with undo (app.js:423-431), and filters/search/focus persist in state (app.js:48-64). No navigation away from the table at any step; Esc closes overlays (app.js:969-975).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are three panels + topbar with an 8-column table and 4 controls per tree row (expander, checkbox, name, policy dot — app.js:179-218). Each surface maps to a brief requirement (scope control, protection, attribution), nothing is clearly removable, but density is high: per-row own-status button + lock button (app.js:274-279), dual status columns (自身状态 + 生效状态·归属), and six global stat chips (index.html:18, app.js:152-157) add permanent load beyond the minimum needed.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks plus type size: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Source corroborates: low-contrast #8a93a6 gray for hints/subtext (styles.css:11,115,193,220 ≈3.1:1 on white), 16px tree expander (styles.css:134-137), ~14px policy dot (styles.css:142), 24px lock button (styles.css:222-224), and modals/drawer/menu rendered into body-end roots with no focus management or trap (app.js:73-76,502-507,775-808). Some credit for real buttons/checkboxes and input focus rings (styles.css:168,296) and title tooltips throughout.

frontend_rework.evidence: 6/7 receipt checks fail (measurement-summary.json:4-6,13-16): layout.overflow=fail and layout.responsive_collision=fail, consistent with the 1280x860 screenshot where the acceptance-critical 生效状态·归属 and 保护 columns are clipped out of view behind horizontal scroll (table min-width:880px, styles.css:177, inside a ~644px middle column at 1280). type.min_projected_size=fail matches 10-10.5px text classes (styles.css:148,193,198,220,344). text.truncation=pass and the 1440x900 render is visually coherent, so not minimal, but the default-viewport loss of the attribution column is a real visible defect.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '批量选择与操作零误伤': scope toggle 仅直属/含子孙 with explanatory hint (index.html:29-34, app.js:826-832), confirmation sheet enumerating each affected device with per-device exclusion checkboxes and live count on the CTA (app.js:537-569,580-586), protected devices default-skipped with explicit opt-in (app.js:561-564,408-414), skip counts in result card (app.js:425-427), undo + full operation log drawer (app.js:434-458,775-808). Seed '状态归属显式': own-status vs effective-status split with provenance labels 自身设定/继承·组名+原因/系统默认 (app.js:74-83,275-276), per-group policy dots opening an impact-preview modal listing every changed device before apply (app.js:632-687). Both seeds are addressed end-to-end in UI and source.

defects_observed: layout.overflow fail (measurement-summary.json) — at 1280x860 the 生效状态·归属 and 保护 columns are horizontally clipped out of view (styles.css:177 table min-width 880px vs ~644px middle panel), hiding part of the status-attribution evidence the brief's seed depends on
layout.responsive_collision fail (measurement-summary.json:11); the colliding state is not visible in either provided static screenshot
a11y.contrast fail — extensive use of --ink-3 #8a93a6 for 10-11.5px hint/subtext text (styles.css:11,115,193,220)

a11y.focus_order fail — confirm/policy modals, drawer, and status menu are injected at body-end roots without focus move or trap (app.js:73-76,502-507,744-763,775-808); no visible focus styles on most buttons
a11y.target_size fail — 16px tree expander (styles.css:134), policy-dot button ~14px (styles.css:142), 24px lock button (styles.css:222-224)

missing_evidence: The specific viewport/state causing layout.responsive_collision=fail cannot be located in the two provided static screenshots; it is cited from the receipt only (measurement-summary.json:11). The single warning in the receipt summary (measurement-summary.json:7) is unlabeled and not attributable to any check.
scores.overall_note: This package implements the brief's job directly and completely: a three-pane batch console (org tree with direct/descendant selection scope, dense 59-device table, dedicated batch-operations panel) whose confirmation sheet enumerates every affected device for per-device exclusion, default-skips protected devices, and reports success/skip counts with undo — squarely covering the acceptance seeds of zero-collateral batch operations and explicit status attribution (own status vs effective status with named provenance, plus a group-policy modal with per-device impact preview). Understandability and navigation are excellent on the initial screen, with the primary entity visible at load and every action context-preserving. The costs are concentrated in measurable surface quality rather than concept: six of seven receipt checks fail, and the source corroborates each failure mode — the attribution columns fall behind horizontal scroll at the default 1280 viewport, gray-on-white small text sits near 3:1 contrast, overlay layers never receive managed focus, and interactive targets run as small as 14-16px. The result is a functionally strong, seed-complete implementation whose accessibility and default-viewport layout would require rework; all salience/understandability scores are model-judged proxies, and human preference is not observable in this pilot.
